title: Prequalification Scheme: Contingent Workforce
metadata_notes:
The NSW Government Prequalification Scheme: Contingent Workforce introduces a new approach for the engagement of contingent
workers by government agencies. It allows suppliers to register for business opportunities through an easy online application process, encouraging participation by more suppliers and the reduction of red tape to streamline the processes for suppliers looking to do business with NSW Government. This report represents spend as reported by suppliers.

title: Home Building Compensation
metadata_notes:
The register contains information about insurance records that the State Insurance Regulatory Authority (SIRA) is required to maintain under section 102A of the Home Building Act 1989.

Search for home building compensation cover (HBC) information in NSW. Retrieve information from the public register such as the insurance certificate number, licence number, principal contractor and property address.

SIRA strongly recommends verifying whether a property has HBC coverage and insurance details by contacting the icare HBCF Customer Support Team either at [email protected] or on 02 8378 0560.

title: Register of Commercial Office Space for Lease
metadata_notes:
Property NSW keeps a Register of Commercial Office Space for Lease, which is intended for information only, and is subject to change and onsite verification.
Property NSW does not warrant the accuracy of the information. The rental stated in the register is subject to contract, and reflective of the current market conditions, or the current rent for the premises in the case of premises leased by the Government and available on a sub-lease.

Information captured by the register includes:
•	Office space address
•	Type of space 
•	Net lettable area (m2)

title: QBCC Licensed Contractors Register
metadata_notes:
Register of licensed builders, trade contractors, designers, nominees, site supervisors and occupational licence holders maintained by the Queensland Building and Construction Commission (QBCC).

All resources are refreshed daily.

Register of licensed builders and contractors = all non-cancelled QBCC Act licences, including both active and suspended. Current-state snapshot.
Suspended Licences = licences suspended at any point during the current financial year to date. Event list, includes licences since reinstated.
Cancelled Licences = licences cancelled at any point during the current financial year to date. Event list.

For up-to-date information on an individual licensee, refer to the QBCC's licence search.
